briefs.title: First Bake, First Light
briefs.prompt: Shoot the four-a.m. bake at 7:10 a.m., once daylight reaches the bench. Set one salt roll on a scratched, dull aluminium baking tray, low in the right-hand third; crop the tray’s nearest corner through the bottom edge. Work at bench height, medium-format 80mm at f/4. Keep the roll’s uneven seam and slightly scorched tip visible, with coarse salt embedded irregularly in the crust. The tray casts a grounded shadow to the right. Leave the upper-left bench bare. Editorial still-life photography, one cohesive series, shot on medium format with a 80mm lens. Color grading: warm neutral base, a single accent hue close to #b45309, low saturation, no neon. Lighting: soft directional window light from the left, bright and airy, gentle long shadows, no flash. Texture: fine film grain, matte surfaces, shallow depth of field on the subject only. No people, no faces, no hands, no body parts anywhere in the frame. No text, no letters, no signs, no logos, no watermarks, no frame or border. Composition leaves clean negative space in the upper-left third for a headline.
briefs.negative: Additional rolls, utensils, linen, butter dishes, ingredient bowls, printed packaging, people or body parts, text, lettering, logos, watermarks, borders, centred symmetry, floating bread, glossy glaze, artificial steam, excessive salt, orange colour cast, neon, flash, multiple light sources, CGI surfaces.
